name: 76039 · Euless, TX
findings: ZIP 76039 (Euless) has 85 nonprofit organizations. 28 of them (33%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 24 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (24% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 76039 (Euless) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
25% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 76039 (Euless) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 51% of the typical level).
